name: AKIKO HARD
source:
Akiko is a special agent who arrives to a suspicious school as a new teacher to investigate rumors about its dark secrets. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
秋子是一名特工，以新老师的身份来到一所可疑的学校，调查关于其黑暗秘密的传闻。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
